items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq seesaw as 10-year yield surges, Big Tech's AI spending ramps up
items.summary: Stocks were on track to end the week on an upbeat note after Big Tech earnings revived optimism in the artificial intelligence trade.

items.title: Amazon's AWS business has taken on a life of its own: Earnings call takeaways
items.summary: Amazon's (AMZN) AWS business saw 37% revenue growth this most recent quarter. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley chats with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about the results and future growth.

items.title: Apple is growing without the AI spending spree engulfing Big Tech: Chart of the Day
items.summary: Apple is growing like an AI spender but isn't spending like one. Thursday's earnings show that route may be cheaper — but it's not free of obstacles.

items.title: Amazon stock soars after Q2 earnings beat expectations as AI, chip businesses see $25 billion run rate
items.summary: Amazon reported its Q2 earnings after the bell on Thursday.

items.title: Amazon Q2 earnings results beat Wall Street's estimates, as AWS continues to boom
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter results on Thursday after the closing bell, with revenue coming in at $200.60 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $197.01 billion). Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré takes a closer look at the breaking numbers.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Advances Despite Spiking Yields; Coinbase Tumbles (Live Coverage)
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rises Friday even as Apple dives on a weak sales forecast. Amazon stock surges on earnings.
